annotations.title: RSSAmp: One webring and its members in order

description:
[RSSAmp] A ring's members in ring order, each with its site, feed, status (active, pending or inactive) and, where the site declared them, made_by and disclosure. The same document as /ring/<slug>/openwebring.json. Use ring_next to follow a hop rather than computing one from this list.

Served by RSSAmp (https://rssamp.com/mcp).
